name: Trash to Treasure: Clean and Restored
tagline: Turn discarded materials into restored community treasure
description: Trash to Treasure turns items and spaces others discard into restored, beautiful resources for community reuse and regeneration.

branchFeatures.description: We pilot litter-removal, restorative planting, and welcoming street furniture to make streets safer and more inviting.
Unsightly traffic zones become places to linger, meet, and discover local makers, artists, and food.
We document community assets and hidden possibilities so every restoration branch is anchored in local stories and care.

missionTitle: Rediscover the treasure in everyday waste
missionText1: Our work shows how small interventions and community care can turn discarded materials and neglected spaces into resources people love.
missionText2: We support communities that want to restore what was thrown away, making beauty and utility out of trash.
